title: Teacher Resume Template
description: Free teacher resume format for Indian schools with B.Ed, CTET/TET scores, subjects and classes taught, teaching experience and results. Edit in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Eligibility first: B.Ed and CTET/TET with year, paper and score
Experience with board, subjects, classes taught and measurable results
One clean single-column page that ATS and principals can scan fast
useCases: TGT and PGT applications to CBSE, ICSE and state board schools
KVS, NVS and private school recruitment drives
research: Indian references put the target post and subject in the headline and list B.Ed and CTET/TET (year, paper, score) on page one, followed by reverse-chronological experience with board, classes and subjects, skills, and medium of instruction in a single-column layout.
